responsibility: This header declares GCC’s internal plugin API used by the compiler core and by plugins built against GCC. It defines the plugin_event enumeration from plugin.def, the plugin argument/info/version data structures, callback and initialization function types, version-check support, registration and unregistration entry points, callback invocation helpers, plugin iteration/reporting routines, and the declarations needed for plugin-provided metadata such as plugin_init and plugin_is_GPL_compatible.
same_name_distinction: Defines the internal/plugin-facing API—types, enum generation via inclusion of gcc/plugin.def, and declarations for registration, invocation, and plugin metadata—whereas gcc/plugin.cc implements that runtime and gcc/plugin.def only enumerates the built-in events.
